author: Diana G
text: Coyle's plumbing has helped me greatly when I was in need of a dependable and affordable plumber! I will be a repeat customer!

author: JT Gluesing
text: Pat did a great job, was fast, responsive, and got along well with our dogs :). For the work done, his price was reasonable. Would hire him again in an instant!

author: Howard “Howie” Vernon
text: Pat is responsive, punctual, & expert in his plumbing skills & knowledge. A very professional & friendly gentleman. It only took him an hour to perform the work & he said payment was not due until he sent us an invoice by USPS.

author: Evan Evans
text: We've  had Pat do a lot of work over many years, both at our house and at a commercial building we own. Always appreciate his skill, honesty and timeliness.We have never had a problem with any work he has done. Highly recommend.

author: David
text: Pat did an amazing job. Fair price, great work, and excellent service. I wouldn't hire anyone else.
